errors.evidence: The x-axis labels are Test1, Test2, Test3, Test4, and Test5. This is a numerical order, not an alphabetical one.

In the list of values for DNN-HMM, the value for Test2 is given as 39%. However, the bar for Test2 is visibly shorter than the bar for Test3 (which is correctly identified as ~39%) and is closer to 38%.

The list of values provided for the TDNN-HMM model is inaccurate. For example, the value for Test1 is approximately 35% (not 36%), for Test2 it is approximately 38% (not 37%), and for Test4 it is approximately 36% (not 35%).
The list of values provided for the LSTM-HMM model is inaccurate. For example, the value for Test3 is approximately 17.5% (not 16%), and the value for Test4 is approximately 16% (not 15%).

The list of values provided for the End-to-End model is inaccurate. The values for Test1 (~17%), Test2 (~16%), and Test3 (~18%) are all underestimated. Crucially, the description incorrectly reports the values for Test1 and Test3 as being the same (16%), when the bar for Test3 is visibly taller than the bar for Test1.
The description omits the label for the x-axis, which is '测试集' (Test Set).
